- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2475-2521 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the retry's PR read fails or omits `.base.ref`, `_rb_retry_base` is cleared and the saved payload is not refreshed. The guard re-runs on the stale base, and the retried merge, bound only to the head SHA, can merge into a clean-audited standalone head after a retarget.
  WHY: The guard is the only base-side gate, and it allows on stale default-base data. Severity disagreement: openai and glm rated it MAJOR. anthropic and minimax rated it a hardening suggestion with risk 1, and anthropic and minimax recommend keeping the fail-open behavior as the accepted tradeoff. glm notes that `test_followup_guard_rerun_keeps_payload_when_base_unreadable_or_unchanged` locks in the fail-open behavior.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2473-2482 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: This is the race lens of the same stale-base window. The retarget-during-delay race is covered only when the retry read succeeds.
  WHY: glm says it is not a separate defect and reports it under CORRECTNESS. Severity is MAJOR.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2506 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: If the base-rewrite `jq -c` fails, the payload becomes empty and the guard fails closed as `unavailable`.
  WHY: glm verified this as sound and found no additional defect (NIT).
